findings.title: `queued` is fixed at module import time
findings.body: `timezone.now()` is evaluated when this module is imported, so every `AssignmentSource` created in the process gets the same `queued` timestamp rather than the time that source was created. The serialized field therefore cannot represent when an assignment was queued, making any timing or freshness information derived from it incorrect. Use a `default_factory` so each instance gets its own timestamp.
